texts.name: Bizz
texts.biography: Bizz is an old air elemental who lived for a long time with the genies. They were the ones who taught her the art of war.

specialty.description: Increases the Speed of allied Air Elementals, Storm Elementals, and Great Air Elementals by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 20% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
specialty.name: Air Elem.
